about: Where a content format takes the person's own words from (DATA, read by src/content-formats.mjs). Each kind is one row: `id` and `label` name it to a person ("From your recording"), `read` names the person store's reader that lists and opens it (`files`: the newest files under `folders`, each with every folder beneath it, whose name ends with one of `name_endings`, with `words_after` cutting a kept transcript's script header off; `pursuits`: the person's pursuits, `title` naming the field that titles one and `fields` the ones whose words fill a format). A new kind is a new row here; a new place a kind lives is a new folder in its row.

before_writing._what: How a finished piece is reached from shaped scripts when a format names no workflow of its own: the AI finds the account's or the Marketplace's workflow for this job with find_workflow and runs it. A saved format's own workflow_id replaces this for that format.

find_workflow.job: Turn the person's notes, recording or thought into a finished piece in their own format, viewpoint and copywriting laws, told as a story and checked line by line before it is kept
